marks.claim: Costco Wholesale Corp. operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites globally, offering low prices on a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products [10-K line 00134]. Its business model is built on high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover through volume purchasing, efficient distribution, and reduced handling in no-frills, self-service warehouse facilities [10-K line 00134]. The company buys most merchandise directly from suppliers, routing it to cross-docking consolidation points or directly to warehouses, creating freight volume and handling efficiencies [10-K line 00135]. Costco operates with shorter hours than many other retailers, resulting in lower labor costs relative to sales volume [10-K line 00140].
